title: Reading: Emails and Messages
focus: Interpretar propósito, destinatário e ação solicitada
verifiableTask: Identificar intenção e próxima ação em três mensagens

content.text: quem escreve para quem, por quê, e o que o leitor precisa fazer
Ao final da aula você consegue:
resumir uma mensagem em uma frase de propósito + uma frase de ação.
identificar intenção e próxima ação em três mensagens.
How many emails do you get per day? Which ones do you read first?
Do you prefer emails or text messages? Why?
I was wondering if you could…
Ouça e repita imitando a melodia (a voz sobe no fim de perguntas sim/não):
Could you send me the file?
I was wondering if you could help me.
I was wondering if you could forward me the email regarding the meeting.

questions.questionText: “Just a reminder that the room is booked until 5.” The purpose is to…
“I'm afraid the course is full.” The writer is…

explanations.general: Correct answer: giving bad news politely

questions.questionText: Please ______ the email to your classmates. (encaminhar)

explanations.general: Please forward the email to your classmates.

questions.questionText: I'm writing ______ your application. (a respeito de)
“Let me know whether you can come.” The reader should…

explanations.general: Correct answer: answer yes or no
Please reply as soon as possible.

content.text: (aluno → professor, empresa → cliente, colega → colega) Isso define o tom.

Please note that Thursday's lab will take place in Room 115 instead of Room 220, because the equipment in 220 is being repaired. The lab will start 15 minutes later than usual, at 2:15. Please bring your safety glasses — we won't have extra pairs. If you can't attend, let me know by Wednesday so I can arrange a make-up session.
informar mudança de sala e horário ·
levar óculos de proteção; avisar até quarta se não puder ir.
→ the library / all users / announce new hours / return books before June 1
→ a classmate / a group / ask for help with slides / reply by tonight
→ the housing office / a student / confirm a room assignment / sign the contract online
4.2 Qual é a ação? (leia e fale)
“Your package is ready. Pick it up at the front desk with your ID by Friday.”
“Hey! Can you save me a seat? I'm running 10 minutes late.”
“We noticed your payment didn't go through. Please update your card information to avoid a late fee.”
“Thanks for applying! No further action is needed at this time. We'll contact you in two weeks.”

questions.questionText: Dr. Patel's email: why is the lab moving?

options.text: Because the class is too big
Because the equipment in Room 220 is being repaired

explanations.C: A hora mudou também, mas não é a causa.
explanations.general: Correct answer: Because the equipment in Room 220 is being repaired

questions.questionText: What time will Thursday's lab start?

explanations.A: Esse era o horário normal (15 min antes).

questions.questionText: What should students who can't attend do?

explanations.C: Não é a ação para quem não pode ir.
explanations.general: Correct answer: Tell Dr. Patel by Wednesday

questions.questionText: “Thanks for applying! No further action is needed at this time.” The reader should…
“Can you save me a seat? I'm running 10 minutes late.” The writer wants the reader to…

explanations.general: Correct answer: keep a seat for him/her

questions.questionText: “Please update your card information to avoid a late ______.” (taxa)

explanations.general: Please update your card information to avoid a late fee.

content.text: 1 min de leitura, depois responda: (a) quem → quem, (b) propósito, (c) próxima ação.

I'm afraid I can't meet on Tuesday after all — my manager scheduled an extra shift. Would Wednesday at 6 work for you? We could meet in the library study room again. If not, I can join online. Please let me know by tonight so I can book the room.

Thank you for your application for on-campus housing. We are happy to offer you a single room in Maple Hall for the fall semester. To accept this offer, please sign the housing agreement in the student portal and pay the $200 deposit no later than June 30. If we do not receive both, the room will be offered to another student.

Thank you for the comments on my essay. I understand most of them, but I'm not sure what you mean by “the argument needs more support” in paragraph 3. Could I come to your office hours on Friday to discuss it? If Friday doesn't work, I'm also free Monday morning.
resuma as 3 mensagens em voz alta, uma frase de propósito + uma de ação para cada.

content.text: 1 retirar o pacote na recepção com documento até sexta; 2 guardar um lugar; 3 atualizar dados do cartão; 4 nenhuma ação — aguardar contato.

M1 Bruno → colegas do grupo | mudar reunião (não pode terça) | responder até hoje à noite se quarta às 6 funciona. M2 Housing Services → aluna | oferecer quarto | assinar contrato no portal e pagar US$200 até 30/06. M3 aluno → professor | pedir reunião para entender comentário | professor confirmar sexta ou segunda.
